text: The annual fee on a retail credit card is waived when total card spend in the previous card year reaches Rs 1,50,000. Otherwise the annual fee of Rs 999 is billed in the anniversary month.

Part-payment or full foreclosure of a floating rate home loan carries no charge for individual borrowers. Prepaid amounts reduce the principal and the customer can choose a lower EMI or a shorter tenure.

Tax (TDS) is deducted on fixed deposit interest above Rs 50,000 in a financial year. Customers below 60 can submit Form 15G, and senior citizens Form 15H, if their total income is below the taxable limit.
A personal loan can be foreclosed after 12 EMIs. Foreclosure charges are 4 percent of the principal outstanding, plus GST.
